results.text: In Vitro Assessment of Potential for CYP-Inhibition-Based Drug-Drug Interaction Between Vonoprazan and Clopidogrel. It was recently proposed that CYP-mediated drug-drug interactions (DDIs) of vonoprazan with clopidogrel and prasugrel can attenuate the antiplatelet actions of the latter two drugs. Clopidogrel is metabolized to the pharmacologically active metabolite H4 and its isomers by multiple CYPs, including CYP2C19 and CYP3A4. results.text: Effects of pantoprazole and esomeprazole on platelet inhibition by clopidogrel. Clopidogrel is activated by CYP2C19, which also metabolizes proton pump inhibitors (PPI). As proton pump inhibitors are metabolized to varying degrees by CYP2C19, we hypothesized that the reported negative omeprazole-clopidogrel drug interaction may not be a class effect.
